title: "Wildfires"
author: "avalee lenard"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson")

fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(
    incident,
    gis_acres,
    fire_year,
    agency,
    state,
    geometry_coordinates
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lon = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(unlist(purrr::map(rings, \(ring) ring[, , 1])))
    ),
    lat = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(unlist(purrr::map(rings, \(ring) ring[, , 2])))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

top_geometries <- purrr::map(
  top_fires$geometry_coordinates,
  \(rings) sf::st_polygon(
    purrr::map(rings, \(ring) cbind(ring[1, , 1], ring[1, , 2]))
  )
) |>
  sf::st_sfc(crs = 4326)

top_fires <- sf::st_sf(top_fires, geometry = top_geometries)
map_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(top_fires)

leaflet::leaflet(top_fires) |>
  leaflet::addTiles() |>
  leaflet::addPolygons(
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
      "Acres: ", format(round(gis_acres), big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    lng1 = map_bounds["xmin"],
    lat1 = map_bounds["ymin"],
    lng2 = map_bounds["xmax"],
    lat2 = map_bounds["ymax"]
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  dplyr::group_by(fire_year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Total Wildfire Acres Burned by Year",
    x = "Fire year",
    y = "Total acres burned",
    caption = "Source: wildfires.geojson"
  )
```
